high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of an article from The Economic Times App, as indicated by the app's logo and rating at the top of the screen. The article discusses business opportunities in the Middle East, specifically focusing on hydrocarbon and solar park projects along with related energy storage solutions. The text mentions that there are opportunities worth $50-60 billion over the next three years, with a roughly $20 billion per year pipeline. It also notes that these opportunities could grow further depending on oil prices and additional capital attraction.
